policy.reference_rule: Use thesis-first structure and intellectual coherence as a quality bar; do not clone visual identity or copy prose.

items.title: 197 passing tests, four real-hardware bugs
items.hard_result: 197 passing unit tests preceded four defects exposed by real RDMA execution

items.title: When uncertainty makes active learning worse
items.hard_result: Greedy DAF 5.15 vs UCB 5.17 at lambda=0.5; uncertainty-error Spearman correlation -0.47; high uncertainty weight collapses DAF to 0.91
items.known_rival: The failure may be specific to output-layer MC dropout, this OOD proxy task, or this pretrained surrogate rather than uncertainty-aware acquisition generally

items.title: A benchmark can measure its own metadata
items.hard_result: 13 of 24 original prompts contained severe author-injected leakage; Euler included the exact ground-truth label while the vulnerable function was absent from committed source
items.claim_boundary: No sanitized model score or causal effect-size claim because paid raw/stripped/anon inference is intentionally not run

items.title: A research primitive should outlive the result that motivated it
items.hard_result: MCDropoutWrapper merged upstream in MatGL #801; application repo reports about 16.5x backbone-once speedup at 20 passes on RTX 3080

items.title: Autograd is part of the API
items.hard_result: MatGL #809 made SoftExponential tensor-native, guarded NaN/Inf gradients, preserved valid-region forward values to 0–5e-7, and passed 92 layer tests

items.title: A default is executable policy
items.hard_result: Merged MLX-LM #1372 changed XTC threshold default from 0.0 to 0.1 across sampler, CLI, and server to avoid a degenerate partial configuration

items.title: Recursion is not one kind of cycle
items.hard_result: Merged Alloy #1105 distinguished legal EIP-712 self-reference from strict runtime resolution and mutual recursion; full alloy-dyn-abi suite passed 194 tests

items.title: Date and time bugs are systems bugs
items.hard_result: Four merged GNU-compatibility fixes cover timezone re-zoning, negative fractional Unix timestamp floor semantics, AM/PM combined parsing, and UT timezone handling

items.title: An invariant is not an end-to-end proof
items.hard_result: Supply≤collateral and adversary-mints-nothing invariants run under 512 runs × depth 100; a gate-off mutation breaks the supply invariant in one call

items.title: Delete the science-fiction parts first
items.claim_boundary: Published as a design note only; physical recovery performance remains target, not observed evidence
items.unblock_condition_for_research_upgrade: Commit instrumented recovery dataset and acceptance-gate results

items.title: Upstream is a different kind of test
items.hard_result: Synthesis is limited to eight merged third-party patches and explicitly treats merge as external evidence, not proof of correctness
